project.description: Name of the project to add xUI to. Defaults to the workspace's default project, or the only application when there is one.

stylesFile.description: Path to the global stylesheet to patch, relative to the workspace root. Detected from the project's build target when omitted.

skipOverlay.description: Do not import the CDK overlay stylesheet. Overlay surfaces (dialog, popover, tooltip, menu, drawer, toast) render in the document flow without it.
